+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# The model (Muse Spark Open at TP8)
+
+TP = 8
+HIDDEN = 8192  # H: the residual stream
+MOE_HIDDEN = 4096  # the pooled width the routed experts see
+INTER = 512  # an expert's intermediate a rank (moe_intermediate_size / TP)
+EXPERTS = 256
+TOPK = 8
+EXPERTS_RANK = EXPERTS // TP  # 32 router rows a rank
+HEADS = 16  # query heads a rank (128 / TP)
+KV_HEADS = 2  # KV heads a rank (16 / TP)
+HEAD_DIM = 64
+CORE = HEADS * HEAD_DIM  # 1024: o_proj's K a rank
+
+# runtime.text_shapes(text_config) must equal MUSE_SHAPES, field by field.
+MUSE_SHAPE_FIELDS = (
+    "hidden_size",
+    "num_attention_heads",
+    "num_key_value_heads",
+    "head_dim",
+    "num_local_experts",
+    "num_experts_per_tok",
+    "moe_hidden_size",
+    "moe_intermediate_size",
+    "num_shared_experts",
+    "sliding_window",
+)
+MUSE_SHAPES = (8192, 128, 16, 64, 256, 8, 4096, 4096, 0, 2048)
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Numerics (refuse_model asserts the loaded modules carry these)
+
+POST_ATTN_EPS = 1e-8  # weightless post_attn_norm
+PRE_FFN_EPS = 1e-5
+PRE_EXP_EPS = 1e-5
+POST_EXP_EPS = 1e-8
+GAIN = 1.0  # fused_gain_center of pre_ffn / pre_expert / post_expert norms
+ROUTE_SCALE = 1.0
+ROUTE_EPS = 1e-15  # router_score_division_eps
+AMAX_FLOOR = 1e-10  # MXFP4 RoundUp: amax = max(amax, AMAX_FLOOR)
+LOG2E = 1.4426950408889634
+
+# Phases B and C (DESIGN_BC section 1.1): the attention front and core.
+RMS_EPS = 1e-5  # pre_qkv_proj_norm, the weightless qk_norm and o_norm
+POST_FFN_EPS = 1e-8  # the previous layer's post_ffn_norm (weight first)
+QK_SCALE_FACTOR = 5.4730064863875  # config.qk_scale_factor
+QK_SCALE = HEAD_DIM**-0.5 * QK_SCALE_FACTOR  # == float(impl.scale)
+QK_SCALE_LOG2E = QK_SCALE * LOG2E  # the split's base-2 logit scale (f32 in-kernel)
+ROPE_THETA = 5e5  # sliding layers' GPT-J RoPE over all 64 dims; full layers: NoPE
+WINDOW = 2048  # sliding layers attend keys L - WINDOW <= k < L
+KV_BLOCK = 16  # tokens a KV page (the kernel block)
+KV_C = 2 * HEAD_DIM  # a (block, head, token) row: K at [0, 64), V at [64, 128)
+V_OFF = HEAD_DIM  # V's element offset in the row
+Q_PER_KV = HEADS // KV_HEADS  # 8 query heads a KV head
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Rows
+
+MAX_ROWS = 8  # rows a served step has at most (the K3 thread maps)
+MAX_TOKENS = 8  # rows scratch and peer memory are sized for
+MAX_PICKS = MAX_TOKENS * TOPK  # 64 (row, k) picks
+MAX_U = MAX_PICKS  # experts in a step's union
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Grid: one CTA per CU, all resident
+
+BLOCKS = 256
+THREADS = 512
+WAVES = THREADS // 64  # 8
+LDS_BYTES = 160 * 1024  # a CU's LDS: one CTA's whole
+VGPR_MAX = 256  # arch + acc VGPRs a lane at 2 waves a SIMD
+ROWS = 16  # output rows of a GEMV task (one MFMA tile)
+COLS = 128  # columns of a seam / gather CTA
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# K2 placement (static; section 5.2 of the design)

+O_TASKS = HIDDEN // ROWS  # 512 o_proj tasks: CTA b runs b and b + BLOCKS
+NA = HIDDEN // COLS  # 64 seam CTAs [0, NA): 128 columns each
+R0 = 64  # router CTAs [R0, R0 + R_TASKS): one expert row each
+R_TASKS = EXPERTS_RANK  # 32
+P_GROUPS = MOE_HIDDEN // TP // ROWS  # 32 pooler row groups a rank
+P_PARTS = 4  # K quarters of a pooler row group
+P_K = HIDDEN // P_PARTS  # 2048
+P0 = 96  # pooler CTAs [P0, P0 + P_TASKS): g = t // P_PARTS, q = t % P_PARTS
+P_TASKS = P_GROUPS * P_PARTS  # 128
+UG_GROUPS = INTER // 32  # 16 ug tasks a union slot (32 columns each)

+W13_STEPS = W13_K // 128  # 32 (16 a K half)
+W2_STEPS = INTER // 128  # 4
+DOWN_TASKS = MOE_HIDDEN // ROWS  # 256 == BLOCKS: CTA b owns rows 16b .. 16b + 16
+DOWN_BATCH = 4  # slots of w2 in flight a wave
+OWN_COLS = MOE_HIDDEN // TP  # 512 pooled columns a rank owns (reduce-scatter)
+RED_TASKS = OWN_COLS // ROWS  # 32 owner CTAs [32 rank, 32 rank + 32)
+U_GROUPS = HIDDEN // TP // ROWS  # 64 unpooler row groups a rank
+U_PARTS = 4  # K quarters of an unpooler row group
+U_K = MOE_HIDDEN // U_PARTS  # 1024
+U_TASKS = U_GROUPS * U_PARTS  # 256: CTA b: g = b // U_PARTS, q = b % U_PARTS
+G_TASKS = HIDDEN // COLS  # 64 gather CTAs [0, G_TASKS)
+
+# MXFP4 activation rows (a1): words a pooled row
+XQ_WORDS = MOE_HIDDEN // 8  # 512 int32 words of packed fp4
+XSC_WORDS = MOE_HIDDEN // 32  # 128 e8m0 codes, one a word in LDS
+
+# LDS route table (common/route_lds.RouteLds): 32-bit words a field
+ROUTE_LDS = dict(
+    route=MAX_TOKENS * 16,  # t*16 + k: id; t*16 + 8 + k: fp32 bits of the weight
+    flag=EXPERTS,
+    expert=MAX_U,
+    kof=MAX_U * 8,
+    scan=WAVES,
+    tot=MAX_TOKENS,
+)
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# K1 placement (Phase B1; DESIGN_BC 5.1): weight-free boundary CTAs [0, NA),
+# the epilogue on CTAs [0, E_UNITS * S), the qkv GEMV on CTAs [NA, BLOCKS)
+
+QKV_ROWS = 2 * CORE + 2 * KV_HEADS * HEAD_DIM  # 2304 a rank: q | k | v | og
+QKV_TILES = QKV_ROWS // ROWS  # 144
+KPARTS = 16  # K parts of a qkv tile
+KPART = HIDDEN // KPARTS  # 512 columns: 4 chunks of 128, one a wave
+K1_TASKS = QKV_TILES * KPARTS  # 2304 (tile, K part) tasks: tau = 16 T + kp
+K1_GEMV0 = NA  # 64: the first GEMV CTA
+K1_GEMV_CTAS = BLOCKS - K1_GEMV0  # 192
+K1_TPC = K1_TASKS // K1_GEMV_CTAS  # 12 tasks a GEMV CTA: tau = 12 g + i
+K1_ROUNDS = K1_TPC // 2  # 6 rounds: waves 0-3 take task 2r, waves 4-7 2r + 1
+K1_MAXC = 2  # GEMV CTAs contributing to a tile
+ROW_Q = 0  # the qkv row blocks: q heads, k heads, v heads, o_gate heads
+ROW_K = CORE
+ROW_V = ROW_K + KV_HEADS * HEAD_DIM
+ROW_G = ROW_V + KV_HEADS * HEAD_DIM
+E_UNITS = 5  # epilogue units a token: q 0-7, q 8-15, k + v, og 0-7, og 8-15
+
+
+def k1_contributor0(tile: int) -> int:
+    """The first of the ``K1_MAXC`` GEMV CTAs (g = b - K1_GEMV0) whose tasks
+    cover ``tile``: contributor c = g - k1_contributor0(tile) holds a run of the
+    tile's K parts, c = 0 the lower ones."""
+    return (KPARTS * tile) // K1_TPC
+
+
+assert K1_TASKS == K1_TPC * K1_GEMV_CTAS and ROWS * QKV_TILES == QKV_ROWS
+assert ROW_G + CORE == QKV_ROWS and KPART * KPARTS == HIDDEN and KPART == 4 * COLS
+assert E_UNITS * MAX_ROWS <= NA and K1_ROUNDS * 2 == K1_TPC
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# K2 split-KV core placement (Phase C, q = 1 widths; DESIGN_BC 7.1). Split
+# unit u = (t * 2 + kvh) * N + p runs on CTA u; combine (t, h) on CTA
+# C0(S) + 16 t + h. A CTA holding both runs its unit first.
+
+NSPLIT_SW = 9  # sliding: <= 129 pages a window -> <= 9 live units
+MIN_PER = 16  # pages a live unit at least: two a wave (two in flight)
+
+
+def nsplit(S: int, window: bool) -> int:
+    """N: units a (token, KV head) (DESIGN_BC 7.1)."""
+    return NSPLIT_SW if window else BLOCKS // (2 * S)
+
+
+def n_units(S: int, window: bool) -> int:
+    """Split units of a launch (CTAs [0, n_units))."""
+    return 2 * S * nsplit(S, window)
+
+
+def n_comb(S: int) -> int:
+    """Combine CTAs of a launch: one a (token, q head), 16 S."""
+    return HEADS * S
+
+
+def C0(S: int) -> int:
+    """The first combine CTA: [C0, BLOCKS) runs one (token, q head) each."""
+    return BLOCKS - n_comb(S)
+
+
+assert all(
+    n_units(s, w) <= BLOCKS and C0(s) >= BLOCKS // 2
+    for s in range(1, MAX_ROWS + 1)
+    for w in (False, True)
+)
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Mailbox tags: tag = (epoch & EPOCH_MASK) * TAG_SLOTS + slot + 1
+
+EPOCH_MASK = (1 << 22) - 1  # kernels use e & EPOCH_MASK: the int32 epoch may wrap
+TAG_SLOTS = 256
+K1_SLOT0 = 0  # Phase B's K1 launches
+K2_SLOT0 = 128  # K2 launches
+
+
+def k1_slot(layer_idx: int) -> int:
+    """The tag slot of a layer's K1 launch (Phase B)."""
+    if not 0 <= layer_idx < K2_SLOT0 - K1_SLOT0:
+        raise ValueError(f"layer {layer_idx} has no K1 slot")
+    return K1_SLOT0 + layer_idx
+
+
+def k2_slot(layer_idx: int) -> int:
+    """The tag slot of a layer's K2 launch."""
+    if not 0 <= layer_idx < TAG_SLOTS - K2_SLOT0:
+        raise ValueError(f"layer {layer_idx} has no K2 slot")
+    return K2_SLOT0 + layer_idx
+
+
+def step_tag(epoch: int, slot: int) -> int:
+    """The host mirror of ``sync.step_tag``: the tag every pair a launch of
+    ``slot`` writes at ``epoch`` carries (two's complement ``&``, so a wrapped,
+    negative int32 epoch gives the kernel's tag too). Never 0: a zeroed pair is
+    never current."""
+    return (epoch & EPOCH_MASK) * TAG_SLOTS + slot + 1
+

+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# TEP8 (K2Build.moe == "ep"): attention stays TP8; rank r owns the experts
+# [32 r, 32 r + 32) at the full intermediate (vLLM's expert-parallel tensors,
+# linear placement). Everything past the experts' rows (the column-owner
+# reduce, the post-expert norm, the unpooler) is the TP8 protocol: the rank
+# holding a pick's expert pushes its whole row, every other rank zeros.

+        # would key a second binary under the same kernel name.
+        if (key.fault_epoch, key.fault_slot, key.fault_ticks) != (0, 0, 0):

+    # gated norm in the core load (B2), "split" the split-KV core in-kernel

+    core: str = "tensor"

+@dataclass(frozen=True)

+def pair_layout(items, align: int = PAIR_BYTES, start: int = 0) -> dict:
+    """``items`` (name, pairs) laid out in order: name -> (byte offset, bytes),
+    each region from an ``align``-byte boundary at or past ``start``."""
+    out, off = {}, start
+    for name, pairs in items:
+        off = (off + align - 1) // align * align
+        out[name] = (off, pairs * PAIR_BYTES)
+        off += pairs * PAIR_BYTES
+    return out
+
+
+def _end(layout: dict) -> int:
+    return max(off + size for off, size in layout.values())
+
+
+def _align(off: int, align: int) -> int:
+    return (off + align - 1) // align * align
+
+
+def scratch_layout() -> dict[str, tuple[int, int]]:
+    """A rank's scratch (one buffer shared by every launch of a step; the tags
+    tell launches apart): the mailboxes, ``RESERVED_A`` bytes, then ``xrow``
+    (16-byte aligned); then Phases B / C's mailboxes and plain regions.
+    name -> (byte offset, bytes)."""
+    out = pair_layout(SCRATCH_PAIRS)
+    out[XROW] = (_align(_end(out) + RESERVED_A, XROW_ALIGN), XROW_BYTES)
+    out.update(pair_layout(SCRATCH_PAIRS_BC, start=_end(out)))
+    off = _end(out)
+    for name, nbytes, align in SCRATCH_PLAIN_BC:
+        off = _align(off, align)
+        if name is not None:
+            out[name] = (off, nbytes)
+        off += nbytes
+    out.update(pair_layout(SCRATCH_PAIRS_EP, start=off))
+    return out
+
+
+def scratch_bytes() -> int:
+    return _end(scratch_layout())
+
+
+def peer_layout() -> dict[str, tuple[int, int]]:
+    """One parity half of a rank's peer buffer: name -> (byte offset, bytes).
+    The kernels see the buffer past ``abi.PEER_HEAD``; parity ``e & 1`` adds
+    ``e & 1`` halves."""
+    return pair_layout(PEER_PAIRS)
+
+
+def peer_half_bytes() -> int:
+    return _end(peer_layout())
+
+
+def peer_bytes() -> int:
+    """Both parity halves; ``abi.PEER_HEAD`` is not included."""
+    return 2 * peer_half_bytes()
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Pair indexes (section 5.10): pair units for put / put_words / poll; put_bf
+# takes the element index 2 * pair. Plain integer arithmetic, so the host tests
+# and the kernels' traced Int32 math read the same formulas.
+
+
+def ar_pair(src, t, col):
+    return ((src * _MT + t) * HIDDEN + col) // 2
+
+
+def rlog_pair(src, t, i):
+    return (src * _MT + t) * EXPERTS_RANK + i
+
+
+def pool_pair(t, col):
+    return (t * MOE_HIDDEN + col) // 2
+
+
+def rsx_pair(src, pick, cc):
+    return ((src * _MP + pick) * OWN_COLS + cc) // 2
+
+
+def sqx_pair(src, pick):
+    return src * _MP + pick
+
+
+def moe_pair(t, col):
+    return (t * MOE_HIDDEN + col) // 2
+
+
+def branch_pair(t, col):
+    return (t * HIDDEN + col) // 2
+
+
+def xrdy_pair(j):
+    return j
+
+
+def ss_pair(j, t):
+    """``ass`` and ``bss`` (K2's seam); ``fss`` and ``nss`` (K1's boundary)."""
+    return j * _MT + t
+
+
+def ppart_pair(g, q, t, r):
+    return ((g * (P_PARTS - 1) + q - 1) * _MT + t) * ROWS + r
+
+
+def route_id_pair(t, k):
+    return t * 16 + k
+
+
+def route_weight_pair(t, k):
+    return t * 16 + 8 + k
+
+
+def pss_pair(j, pick):
+    return j * _MP + pick
+
+
+def inter_ep_pair(pick, g, w):
+    return pick * EP_GEOM.inter_words + 4 * g + w
+
+
+def isc_ep_pair(pick, g):
+    return pick * EP_GEOM.ug_groups + g
+
+
+def upart_pair(g, q, t, r):
+    return ((g * (U_PARTS - 1) + q - 1) * _MT + t) * ROWS + r
+
+
+def ardy_pair(j):
+    return j
+
+
+def qpart_pair(T, c, t, r):
+    """K1: contributor c's partial of qkv tile T's row r for token t."""
+    return ((T * K1_MAXC + c) * _MT + t) * ROWS + r
+
+
+def srdy_pair(u):
+    return u
+
+
+def crdy_pair(t, h):

+

+# Plain (untagged) regions: word / element indexes from the region's base.
+
+
+def xrow_elem(t, col):
+    """``xrow`` bf16 element of row t, column col."""
+    return t * HIDDEN + col
+
+
+def arow_elem(t, col):
+    """``arow`` bf16 element of row t, column col."""
+    return t * HIDDEN + col
+
+
+def xo_elem(t, h, d):
+    """``xo`` bf16 element of token t, q head h, dim d."""
+    return t * CORE + HEAD_DIM * h + d
+
+
+def pstat_word(u, j, k):
+    """``pstat`` fp32 word of split unit u, its q head j (of 8), k = 0: the
+    running max m (base 2), k = 1: the sum l."""
+    return (u * Q_PER_KV + j) * 2 + k

+
+def opart_word(u, j, d):
+    """``opart`` fp32 word of split unit u, its q head j, dim d."""

+"""K2 phase 3b: the routed experts of one Muse Spark layer and rank, from the
+MXFP4 pre-expert-normed pooled rows (``xq`` / ``xsc`` in LDS, ``pool.load_xq``)
+to every pick's bf16 rows pushed to their column owner (``rsx``).
+
+Adapted from K3's latent MoE (pr60683 ``kimi_k3/amd/specialized_decode/mono/
+stages/moe.py``: ``load_route``, ``ug_loads`` / ``stage_ug``, ``load_inter``,
+``down_loads`` / ``stage_down``) to Muse's shapes (256 experts, top-8, I_local
+512, pooled K 4096), its stage-1 numerics (aiter's SiLU, a bf16 h, the RoundUp
+MXFP4 a2) and its reduce (unweighted rows, reduced by the column owner).
+
+    union  (every CTA, ``load_route``): ROUTE -> the LDS route table; the union U
+           of the step's live picks (``0 <= id < 256``; pad rows carry -1, a
+           garbage id after a timed-out poll is dead too): ``slot_of[e]``,
+           ``expert[slot]`` ascending (zeroed past |U|), ``kof[slot 8 + t]``
+    ug     (|U| x 16 tasks, every CTA, reversed placement, ``run_ug``): 32 gate +
+           32 up rows of a slot's expert against the MXFP4 rows (FP4 x FP4
+           scaled MFMA, K halves on waves 0-3 / 4-7), SiLU (aiter: hw exp2 /
+           rcp), h rounded to bf16, MXFP4 a 32-column group (RoundUp) ->
+           INTER / ISC of each picking row
+    down   (CTA b: 16 of the 4096 pooled rows, ``run_down``): w2 of every slot
+           against its picks' INTER (live picks only polled) -> a bf16 row a
+           pick, UNWEIGHTED (the post-expert norm comes before the route weight)
+           -> the owner rank's RSX (``b // 32``), zeros included
+
+Pad rule: a dead pick (pad row, garbage id) is never in U and never polled; its
+contribution rows stay the zeros ``load_inter`` stores (``select``, never a mask
+multiply). Every expert id is clamped into [0, 256) and every slot into
+[0, MAX_U) at each address use, so a timed-out step keeps its addresses in
+bounds. Every stage here touching the stage LDS or ``red`` ends with a barrier
+(the LDS hand-over rule).

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- LDS

+_UG_LDS: dict = {}
+_DOWN_LDS: dict = {}

+def ug_lds_struct(s: int):
+    """The ug epilogue's buffer: ``av`` f32[THREADS], a (row, column) thread's bf16
+    h, read back 8 at a time for the fp4 pack. K2 lays it out after

+def down_lds_struct(s: int):
+    """The down stage's operands: ``interq`` (a pick's 64 a2 words), ``intsc`` (its 16
+    codes) and ``contrib`` (its 16 bf16-rounded rows of this CTA), s 8 picks."""
+    if s not in _DOWN_LDS:

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- indexes
+# Plain integer arithmetic: the kernels' traced Int32 math and the host tests

+def inter_word(pick, g, w, geom=TP_GEOM):
+    """``inter`` pair of a pick's a2 word w (columns 32 g + 8 w .. + 8) of
+    32-column group g (EP: ``inter_ep``, with ``geom`` = ``EP_GEOM``)."""
+    return pick * geom.inter_words + 4 * g + w
+
+
+def inter_read_word(pick, st, kb, d):
+    """The a2 word a down lane (K block ``kb`` = lane / 16) feeds its MFMA at
+    128-K step ``st``: the K order of w2's ``fp4_tile_load`` (K 128 st + 32 kb
+    + 8 d ..)."""
+    return pick * INTER_WORDS + 16 * st + 4 * kb + d
+
+
+def isc_index(pick, g, geom=TP_GEOM):
+    """``isc`` pair of a pick's group-g a2 code (EP: ``isc_ep``)."""
+    return pick * geom.ug_groups + g
+
+
+def xq_read_word(t, st, kb, d):
+    """The a1 word (``pool.load_xq``'s ``xq[t 512 + kb' 4 + w]``, kb' the
+    32-column block) a ug lane feeds its MFMA at step ``st``, K block ``kb``."""
+    return t * XQ_WORDS + 16 * st + 4 * kb + d
+
+
+def ug_row_group(wave, g, geom=TP_GEOM):
+    """The w13 16-row group wave ``wave`` multiplies for 32-column group ``g``:
+    waves 0 / 4 gate rows 32 g .., 1 / 5 gate 32 g + 16 .., 2 / 6 up rows
+    512 + 32 g .., 3 / 7 up 512 + 32 g + 16 .. (a 32-row scale block holds two
+    gate or two up groups, never one of each)."""
+    rgl = wave % 4
+    return (rgl // 2) * geom.up_group0 + 2 * g + rgl % 2
+
+
+def rsx_elem(rank, pick, rgd, rp):
+    """``put_bf`` element index of down CTA ``rgd``'s column pair ``rp`` of a
+    pick in its owner's ``rsx`` (2 ``spec.rsx_pair``)."""
+    return (rank * MAX_PICKS + pick) * OWN_COLS + (rgd % RED_TASKS) * ROWS + 2 * rp
+
+
+def slot_expert(c, slot, ep=False):
+    """Union slot ``slot``'s expert id, wave-uniform, the slot clamped into
+    [0, MAX_U) and the id into [0, EXPERTS): an in-bounds weight address for
+    any slot (past |U| ``expert`` holds 0) or garbage id. ``ep``: the expert's
+    index in this rank's 32 (clamped into [0, 32))."""
+    sl = fx.max(fx.min(slot, MAX_U - 1), 0)
+    e = clamp_expert(uniform(fx.ptr_load(c["rt"]["expert"] + sl)))
+    if const_expr(ep):
+        e = fx.max(fx.min(e - EXPERTS_LOCAL * c["rank"], EXPERTS_LOCAL - 1), 0)
+    return e
+
+
+def _pick_id(rt, pick):
+    """The expert id of pick ``pick`` = t 8 + k in the LDS route table."""
+    return fx.ptr_load(rt["route"] + id_index(pick // TOPK, pick % TOPK))
+
+
+def _live(e):
+    return (e >= 0) & (e < EXPERTS)
+
+
+def _local(c, e):
+    """Expert ``e`` is one of this rank's 32 (TEP8, linear placement)."""
+    lo = EXPERTS_LOCAL * c["rank"]
+    return (e >= lo) & (e < lo + EXPERTS_LOCAL)

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- union

+@traced
+def load_route(c, ep=False):
+    """ROUTE -> the LDS route table (ids, weight bits) and the union U of the
+    live picks: ``flag[e]`` (U's slot of e), ``expert[slot]`` (ascending, 0
+    past |U|), ``kof[slot 8 + t]`` (row t's top-k index of the slot's expert,
+    -1 when t did not pick it). LDS is not zeroed at launch: every field read
+    later is written here first. Returns |U| (wave-uniform), 0 when every row
+    is a pad. ``ep``: U is the step's union within this rank's 32 experts (a
+    pick of another rank's expert is not a slot here; its kof stays -1)."""

+    rt = c["rt"]
+    tid32 = fx.Int32(tid)
+    if tid < s * 16:
+        v = c["poll"]([(c["scr"]["route"], tid32, 1)])[0][0]
+        fx.ptr_store(v, rt["route"] + tid32)
+    if tid < EXPERTS:
+        fx.ptr_store(fx.Int32(0), rt["flag"] + tid32)
+    if tid < MAX_U:
+        fx.ptr_store(fx.Int32(0), rt["expert"] + tid32)
+    fx.ptr_store(fx.Int32(-1), rt["kof"] + tid32)  # MAX_U 8 == THREADS words
+    gpu.barrier()

+        e = _pick_id(rt, tid32)
+        on = _live(e)
+        if const_expr(ep):
+            on = on & _local(c, e)

+            fx.ptr_store(fx.Int32(1), rt["flag"] + clamp_expert(e))

+        fx.ptr_load(rt["flag"] + fx.min(tid32, EXPERTS - 1)), fx.Int32(0)

+        on = _live(e)
+        if const_expr(ep):

+        if on:

+            fx.ptr_store(tid32 % TOPK, rt["kof"] + (sl * 8 + tid32 // TOPK))
+    gpu.barrier()
+    return fx.min(uniform(tot), fx.Int32(MAX_U))

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- ug

+def ug_loads(c, task, geom=TP_GEOM):
+    """Task ``task``'s w13 operands for this wave (its row group, its K half:
+    16 dwordx4) and their scale words (8: a word serves 2 steps x 2 row
+    groups), issued a task ahead (``stage_ug`` takes them). The task is the
+    caller's, clamped to the step's last (``run_ug``)."""
+    lane, wave = c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    a = c["args"]
+    e = slot_expert(c, task // geom.ug_groups, geom is EP_GEOM)
+    rg = ug_row_group(wave, task % geom.ug_groups, geom)
+    st0 = (wave // 4) * HALF_STEPS
+    r_w = rsrc(a["w13"])
+    base = e * geom.w13_expert_dwords
+    av = [
+        fp4_tile_load(r_w, base, rg, W13_K, st0 + i, lane * 4)
+        for i in range(HALF_STEPS)
+    ]
+    r_s = rsrc(a["w13s"])
+    sw = [
+        fx.Int32(
+            bo.buffer_load(
+                r_s,
+                w13_scale_word(e, rg, st0 + i, lane, rows=geom.w13_rows),
+                vec_width=1,
+                dtype=T.i32,
+            )
+        )
+        for i in range(0, HALF_STEPS, 2)
+    ]
+    return av + sw
+

+@traced
+def stage_ug(c, task, ops, geom=TP_GEOM):

+    up rows 512 + 32 g .. of the slot's expert (``ops``: ``ug_loads``) against
+    the MXFP4 rows; thread (row tt = tid / 32, column) sums its gate / up over
+    the K halves, h = bf16((g sigmoid(g)) u) (aiter's ``silu_mul``: hw exp2 and
+    rcp), the 32-column group's RoundUp code, the fp4 pack -> INTER / ISC of
+    every row that picked the expert."""
+    s, tid, lane, wave, red = c["S"], c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"], c["red"]
+    rt, xq = c["rt"], c["lds"]["xq"]

+    g = task % geom.ug_groups

+    t = fx.min(lane % 16, s - 1)
+    kb = lane // 16
+    acc = fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32)
+    for i in range_constexpr(HALF_STEPS):
+        st = st0 + i
+        bw = fx.Vector(
+            fx.ptr_load(
+                xq["xq"] + xq_read_word(t, st, kb, 0),
+                result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Int32),
+            )
+        )
+        sb = fx.ptr_load(xq["xsc"] + (t * XSC_WORDS + st * 4 + kb))
+        # the code's byte (st % 2) 2 + rg % 2 of the word (st % 2 == i % 2)
+        sa = (ops[HALF_STEPS + i // 2] >> ((i % 2) * 16 + (rg % 2) * 8)) & 0xFF

+    col = tid % 32

+@traced
+def run_ug(c, nu, geom=TP_GEOM):
+    """Every ug task of the step (|U| x 16) over the grid, reversed placement
+    (CTA b: tasks 255 - b, + 256, ...: the leftover tasks of the last round go
+    to the high CTAs, whose early work ends first), the next task's weights in
+    flight under this one's MFMAs. ``nu == 0`` runs no task (task index 0's
+    loads, expert 0, are issued and unused)."""
+    total = nu * geom.ug_groups
+    last = fx.max(total - 1, 0)
+    task = BLOCKS - 1 - fx.Int32(c["bid"])
+    ops = ug_loads(c, fx.min(task, last), geom)

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- down

+def down_loads(c, rgd, nu, b0):

+    b0 + 8, ... (DOWN_BATCH; past |U| the last slot's, and expert 0 when U is

+    a = c["args"]
+    r_w = rsrc(a["w2"])
+    r_s = rsrc(a["w2s"])

+        fp4_tile_load(r_w, es[j] * W2_EXPERT_DWORDS, rgd, INTER, st, lane * 4)

+def _inter_spec(rt, route, a, idx, pick):
+    """(poll spec, live) of INTER pair ``idx`` of a WAVE-UNIFORM pick ``pick``
+    (``wave + 8 i``: a wave's 64 words are one pick's): a dead pick's pair has
+    no producer, so the spec names the pick's own ROUTE pair instead (produced
+    for every row; ``load_route`` saw it current), whose value the caller
+    drops. The id goes through ``uniform``, so the base select is scalar and
+    the buffer resource stays in SGPRs."""
+    ok = _live(uniform(_pick_id(rt, pick)))
+    at = Addr(a.region, a.space, fx.Int64(ok.select(a.value, route.value)))
+    rix = id_index(pick // TOPK, pick % TOPK)
+    return (at, ok.select(idx, rix), 1), ok

+
+def _isc_spec(rt, route, idx, pick):
+    """(poll spec, live) of ISC pair ``idx`` of pick ``pick``, which differs
+    across a wave (16 codes a pick): as ``_inter_spec``, but the dead / live
+    choice is made in the INDEX over one wave-uniform base, ``route`` (ISC
+    sits ``ISC_FROM_ROUTE`` pairs past it in the scratch). A per-lane base
+    would make the buffer resource divergent, and the compiler then wraps every
+    load of the poll loop in a readfirstlane waterfall. The spec keeps the
+    region name ``isc``; a give-up record never names it (a batch's record
+    names its first spec, an INTER one)."""
+    ok = _live(_pick_id(rt, pick))
+    at = Addr("isc", route.space, route.value)
+    rix = id_index(pick // TOPK, pick % TOPK)
+    return (at, ok.select(idx + ISC_FROM_ROUTE, rix), 1), ok

+@traced
+def load_inter(c):
+    """The step's INTER words and ISC codes -> LDS ``interq`` / ``intsc``, live
+    picks only: a dead pick (pad row, garbage id) has no producer, so it gets
+    zero words and the unit code without a poll (its pair is replaced in the
+    poll batch by the pick's own ROUTE pair, which ``load_route`` already saw
+    current, so the batch stays one round trip). Also zeroes ``contrib``."""
+    s, tid, wave = c["S"], c["tid"], c["wave"]
+    rt, d, scr = c["rt"], c["lds"]["down"], c["scr"]
+    tid32 = fx.Int32(tid)
+    inter, route = scr["inter"], scr["route"]
+
+    nw = s * TOPK * INTER_WORDS  # a multiple of THREADS
+    nc = s * TOPK * UG_GROUPS
+    specs, oks = [], []
+    for i in range_constexpr(nw // THREADS):
+        idx = tid32 + THREADS * i  # pick idx // 64 = wave + 8 i
+        pick = fx.Int32(wave) + (THREADS // INTER_WORDS) * i

+        oks.append(ok)

+                 pick is polled
+    down         (CTA b: pooled rows 16 b .., ``stage_down_ep``) wave w the
+                 K steps 4 w .. 4 w + 3 of every local slot's w2
+                 (DOWN_BATCH_EP slots in flight) -> its fp32 ``part``; the 8
+                 waves' parts summed in wave order -> ``res[pick]``
+    push         every pick's 16 rows, rounded once to bf16, to the column
+                 owner's RSX (``b // 32``): a local pick its row, any other
+                 exact zeros, so the owner's 8-rank fp32 sum
+                 (``reduce.stage_owner``, unchanged) is the producing rank's row
+
+The chunk loop runs once unless more than EP_STAGE_PICKS of the step's picks
+are this rank's (each further chunk streams the w2 again). The union
+(``experts.load_route(c, ep=True)``) and ug (``experts.run_ug(c, nu,
+EP_GEOM)``, a2 into ``inter_ep`` / ``isc_ep``) are TP8's stages at EP's
+geometry. Pad rule and clamps as ``experts``: a dead or non-local pick is never
+polled and never multiplied in (``select``, never a mask multiply); every
+slot / expert / local index is clamped at each address use.
+"""
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from flydsl.expr import gpu, range_constexpr
+
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.mx import (
+    FP4,
+    UNIT_SCALE,
+    fp4_tile_load,
+    mfma_scaled,
+    scale_byte,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ops import (
+    bf16_round,
+    block_excl_scan,
+    rsrc,
+    traced,
+    uniform,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ranks import peer_at
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.route_lds import (
+    id_index,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.sync import Addr
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.spec import (
+    DOWN_BATCH_EP,
+    EP_GEOM,
+    EP_PICK_CODES,
+    EP_PICK_WORDS,
+    EP_STAGE_PICKS,
+    EP_WAVE_STEPS,
+    MAX_PICKS,
+    MOE_HIDDEN,
+    RED_TASKS,
+    ROWS,
+    THREADS,
+    TOPK,
+    WAVES,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.stages.experts import (
+    _live,
+    _local,
+    _pick_id,
+    rsx_elem,
+    slot_expert,
+)
+
+P = EP_STAGE_PICKS
+CODE_WAVES = EP_PICK_CODES // 64  # 2: waves a pick's codes span
+# This rank's w2 and its e8m0 codes, bytes; past them a load is out of range.
+W2_BYTES = EP_GEOM.experts * EP_GEOM.w2_expert_dwords * 4  # 256 MiB
+W2S_BYTES = EP_GEOM.experts * MOE_HIDDEN * EP_GEOM.ug_groups  # 16 MiB
+OOB_DWORD = 1 << 28  # a w2 dword index past W2_BYTES (its byte offset < 2^32)
+OOB_ROW = 1 << 20  # a w2 scale row past W2S_BYTES (scale_index < 2^32)
+assert OOB_DWORD * 4 > W2_BYTES + (1 << 26) and (OOB_DWORD + (1 << 26)) * 4 < 1 << 32
+assert OOB_ROW * EP_GEOM.ug_groups > W2S_BYTES
+assert EP_PICK_CODES % 64 == 0 and THREADS % EP_PICK_CODES == 0
+
+_DOWN_LDS: dict = {}
+
+
+def down_lds_struct(s: int):
+    """The EP down stage's LDS: a chunk's whole a2 rows (``interq``, 512 words a
+    local pick; ``intsc``, 128 codes), every wave's fp32 partial rows of each
+    staged pick (``part``), every pick's summed rows (``res``) and the local
+    pick tables (``lpof``, ``pickof``)."""
+    if s not in _DOWN_LDS:
+
+        @fx.struct
+        class DownLdsEp:
+            interq: fx.Array[fx.Int32, P * EP_PICK_WORDS, 16]
+            intsc: fx.Array[fx.Int32, P * EP_PICK_CODES, 16]
+            part: fx.Array[fx.Float32, WAVES * P * ROWS, 16]
+            res: fx.Array[fx.Float32, s * TOPK * ROWS, 16]
+            lpof: fx.Array[fx.Int32, MAX_PICKS, 16]
+            pickof: fx.Array[fx.Int32, MAX_PICKS, 16]
+
+        _DOWN_LDS[s] = DownLdsEp
+    return _DOWN_LDS[s]
+
+
+def down_loads_ep(c, rgd, nu, b0):
+    """The w2 tiles of a wave's K steps 4 w .. 4 w + 3 and their scale codes for
+    the slots b0 .. b0 + DOWN_BATCH_EP (past |U| the last slot's, local expert
+    0 when U is empty): flat, tiles then codes. Pooled rows 16 rgd .."""
+    lane, wave = c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    a = c["args"]
+    # bounded resources: a slot past |U| addresses past the end, and an
+    # out-of-range buffer load returns 0 without touching memory (its MFMA
+    # result is never stored: ``picked`` is false for it)
+    r_w = rsrc(a["w2"], W2_BYTES)
+    r_s = rsrc(a["w2s"], W2S_BYTES)
+    sls = [b0 + j for j in range(DOWN_BATCH_EP)]
+    es = [slot_expert(c, fx.min(sl, nu - 1), True) for sl in sls]
+    bases = [
+        (sl < nu).select(e * EP_GEOM.w2_expert_dwords, fx.Int32(OOB_DWORD))
+        for sl, e in zip(sls, es)
+    ]
+    rows = [
+        (sl < nu).select(e * MOE_HIDDEN + rgd * ROWS + lane % 16, fx.Int32(OOB_ROW))
+        for sl, e in zip(sls, es)
+    ]
+    sts = [fx.Int32(wave) * EP_WAVE_STEPS + q for q in range(EP_WAVE_STEPS)]
+    av = [
+        fp4_tile_load(r_w, bases[j], rgd, EP_GEOM.inter, st, lane * 4)
+        for j in range(DOWN_BATCH_EP)
+        for st in sts
+    ]
+    sa = [
+        scale_byte(r_s, rows[j], 4 * st + lane // 16, EP_GEOM.ug_groups)
+        for j in range(DOWN_BATCH_EP)
+        for st in sts
+    ]
+    return av + sa
+
+
+@traced
+def local_picks(c):
+    """This rank's live local picks in pick order: ``lpof[pick]`` (its local
+    index, -1 for any other pick), ``pickof[lp]``; ``res`` zeroed. Returns n_lp
+    (CTA-uniform). Ends with a barrier."""
+    s, tid, lane, wave = c["S"], c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    rt, d = c["rt"], c["lds"]["down"]
+    tid32 = fx.Int32(tid)
+    npk = s * TOPK
+    e = _pick_id(rt, fx.min(tid32, npk - 1))
+    ok = (tid32 < npk) & _live(e) & _local(c, e)
+    off, tot = block_excl_scan(
+        ok.select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0)), lane, wave, rt["scan"]
+    )
+    if tid < npk:
+        fx.ptr_store(ok.select(off, fx.Int32(-1)), d["lpof"] + tid32)
+    if ok:
+        fx.ptr_store(tid32, d["pickof"] + off)
+    for i in range_constexpr((npk * ROWS + THREADS - 1) // THREADS):
+        idx = tid32 + THREADS * i
+        if idx < npk * ROWS:
+            fx.ptr_store(fx.Float32(0.0), d["res"] + idx)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    return uniform(tot)
+
+
+def _ep_spec(c, route, a, idx, pick, ok):
+    """(poll spec) of the 2 pairs at ``idx`` of region ``a`` for a WAVE-UNIFORM
+    ``ok``: a staging slot past n_lp has no producer, so the spec names pick
+    ``pick``'s ROUTE pairs instead (its id and the next pair, produced for every
+    row; ``load_route`` saw them current), whose values the caller drops. The
+    base select is scalar (``ok`` is wave-uniform)."""
+    at = Addr(a.region, a.space, fx.Int64(ok.select(a.value, route.value)))
+    rix = id_index(pick // TOPK, pick % TOPK)
+    return (at, ok.select(idx, rix), 2)
+
+
+POLL_GROUP = 16  # local picks a poll round trip stages (10 specs of 2 pairs)
+WORD_THREADS = EP_PICK_WORDS // 2  # 256: threads a pick's words (2 a thread)
+CODE_THREADS = EP_PICK_CODES // 2  # 64: threads a pick's codes (one wave)
+assert THREADS % WORD_THREADS == 0 and CODE_THREADS == 64
+assert POLL_GROUP % (THREADS // WORD_THREADS) == 0 and POLL_GROUP % WAVES == 0
+
+
+@traced
+def load_inter_ep(c, c0, n_lp):
+    """Local picks c0 .. c0 + P (those below n_lp): their whole a2 rows ->
+    ``interq`` (words), ``intsc`` (codes), POLL_GROUP picks a round trip (a
+    dynamic loop: n_lp <= 16 costs one); a staging slot past n_lp gets zero
+    words and the unit code without a poll. A wave's 64 threads poll one
+    pick's pairs, so every spec is wave-uniform. Ends with a barrier."""
+    tid, lane, wave = c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    d, scr = c["lds"]["down"], c["scr"]
+    tid32 = fx.Int32(tid)
+    route = scr["route"]
+    end = fx.min(n_lp - c0, fx.Int32(P))
+    wp = THREADS // WORD_THREADS  # 2 picks' words a pass
+    g0 = fx.Int32(0)
+    while g0 < end:
+        specs, oks, lps = [], [], []
+        for i in range_constexpr(POLL_GROUP // wp):  # words 2 (tid % 256), + 1
+            lpl = uniform(g0 + wp * i + tid32 // WORD_THREADS)  # a wave's 64 words
+            ok = lpl < end
+            pick = uniform(fx.ptr_load(d["pickof"] + fx.min(c0 + lpl, MAX_PICKS - 1)))
+            pick = ok.select(pick, fx.Int32(0))
+            pair = pick * EP_PICK_WORDS + 2 * (tid32 % WORD_THREADS)
+            specs.append(_ep_spec(c, route, scr["inter_ep"], pair, pick, ok))
+            oks.append(ok)
+            lps.append(fx.min(lpl, P - 1))
+        for i in range_constexpr(POLL_GROUP // WAVES):  # codes 2 lane, + 1
+            lpl = uniform(g0 + WAVES * i + fx.Int32(wave))
+            ok = lpl < end
+            pick = uniform(fx.ptr_load(d["pickof"] + fx.min(c0 + lpl, MAX_PICKS - 1)))
+            pick = ok.select(pick, fx.Int32(0))
+            pair = pick * EP_PICK_CODES + 2 * fx.Int32(lane)
+            specs.append(_ep_spec(c, route, scr["isc_ep"], pair, pick, ok))
+            oks.append(ok)
+            lps.append(fx.min(lpl, P - 1))
+        got = c["poll"](specs)
+        nwp = POLL_GROUP // wp
+        for i in range_constexpr(nwp):
+            at = d["interq"] + (lps[i] * EP_PICK_WORDS + 2 * (tid32 % WORD_THREADS))
+            for q in range_constexpr(2):
+                fx.ptr_store(oks[i].select(got[i][q], fx.Int32(0)), at + q)
+        for i in range_constexpr(POLL_GROUP // WAVES):
+            j = nwp + i
+            at = d["intsc"] + (lps[j] * EP_PICK_CODES + 2 * fx.Int32(lane))
+            for q in range_constexpr(2):
+                fx.ptr_store(oks[j].select(got[j][q], fx.Int32(UNIT_SCALE)), at + q)
+        g0 = g0 + POLL_GROUP
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+@traced
+def stage_down_ep(c, rgd, nu, c0, ops0):
+    """Wave w's K steps 4 w .. 4 w + 3 of every local slot's w2 against the
+    staged a2 of its picks in this chunk (DOWN_BATCH_EP slots in flight, the
+    next batch issued under this one's MFMAs; ``ops0`` the first, issued
+    before the a2 poll) -> the wave's fp32 ``part``; then the waves' parts
+    summed in wave order into ``res[pick]``. Ends with a barrier."""
+    s, tid, lane, wave = c["S"], c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    rt, d = c["rt"], c["lds"]["down"]
+    t = fx.min(lane % 16, s - 1)
+    kb = lane // 16
+    tok = lane % 16 < s
+    nbs = DOWN_BATCH_EP * EP_WAVE_STEPS
+    b0 = fx.Int32(0)
+    ops = ops0
+    while b0 < nu:
+        nb = b0 + DOWN_BATCH_EP
+        ops_n = down_loads_ep(c, rgd, nu, nb)
+        for j in range_constexpr(DOWN_BATCH_EP):
+            sl = b0 + j
+            slot = fx.max(fx.min(sl, nu - 1), 0)
+            k = fx.ptr_load(rt["kof"] + (slot * 8 + t))
+            pick = t * TOPK + fx.max(fx.min(k, TOPK - 1), 0)
+            lp = fx.ptr_load(d["lpof"] + pick) - c0
+            picked = (k >= 0) & tok & (sl < nu) & (lp >= 0) & (lp < P)
+            lpc = fx.max(fx.min(lp, P - 1), 0)
+            acc = fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32)
+            for q in range_constexpr(EP_WAVE_STEPS):
+                st = fx.Int32(wave) * EP_WAVE_STEPS + q
+                bw = fx.Vector(
+                    fx.ptr_load(
+                        d["interq"] + (lpc * EP_PICK_WORDS + 16 * st + 4 * kb),
+                        result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Int32),
+                    )
+                )
+                bw = fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                    [picked.select(bw[x], fx.Int32(0)) for x in range(4)], fx.Int32
+                )
+                code = fx.ptr_load(d["intsc"] + (lpc * EP_PICK_CODES + 4 * st + kb))
+                sb = picked.select(code, fx.Int32(UNIT_SCALE))
+                acc = mfma_scaled(
+                    ops[j * EP_WAVE_STEPS + q],
+                    bw,
+                    acc,
+                    ops[nbs + j * EP_WAVE_STEPS + q],
+                    sb,
+                    FP4,
+                    FP4,
+                    0,
+                    0,
+                )
+            # lane: rows 4 (lane / 16) + i of row t's pick
+            if picked:
+                for i in range_constexpr(4):
+                    fx.ptr_store(
+                        acc[i],
+                        d["part"] + ((fx.Int32(wave) * P + lpc) * ROWS + 4 * kb + i),
+                    )
+        b0 = nb
+        ops = ops_n
+    gpu.barrier()
+    # thread (staged pick lp, row r): the 8 waves' parts in wave order
+    lp = fx.Int32(tid) // ROWS
+    r = fx.Int32(tid) % ROWS
+    if c0 + lp < c["n_lp"]:
+        v = fx.ptr_load(d["part"] + (lp * ROWS + r))
+        for w in range_constexpr(1, WAVES):
+            v = v + fx.ptr_load(d["part"] + ((w * P + lp) * ROWS + r))
+        pick = fx.ptr_load(d["pickof"] + fx.min(c0 + lp, MAX_PICKS - 1))
+        fx.ptr_store(v, d["res"] + (pick * ROWS + r))
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+@traced
+def push_ep(c, rgd):
+    """Every pick's 16 rows of ``res`` (zeros past the local picks), rounded
+    once to bf16, to the column owner's RSX (``rgd // 32``). Ends with a
+    barrier."""
+    s, tid = c["S"], c["tid"]
+    d = c["lds"]["down"]
+    if tid < s * TOPK * (ROWS // 2):
+        pick = fx.Int32(tid) // (ROWS // 2)
+        rp = fx.Int32(tid) % (ROWS // 2)
+        v0 = bf16_round(fx.ptr_load(d["res"] + (pick * ROWS + 2 * rp)))
+        v1 = bf16_round(fx.ptr_load(d["res"] + (pick * ROWS + 2 * rp + 1)))
+        c["put_bf"](
+            peer_at(c["peer"]["rsx"], rgd // RED_TASKS),
+            rsx_elem(c["rank"], pick, rgd, rp),
+            [v0, v1],
+        )
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+@traced
+def run_down_ep(c, rgd, nu):
+    """CTA ``rgd``'s EP down task: the local picks, then a chunk of them at a
+    time (once, unless more than EP_STAGE_PICKS): the first w2 batch issued
+    before the a2 polls, ``load_inter_ep``, ``stage_down_ep``; then the
+    pushes."""
+    n_lp = local_picks(c)
+    c["n_lp"] = n_lp
+    c0 = fx.Int32(0)
+    while c0 < n_lp:
+        ops = down_loads_ep(c, rgd, nu, fx.Int32(0))
+        load_inter_ep(c, c0, n_lp)
+        stage_down_ep(c, rgd, nu, c0, ops)
+        c0 = c0 + P
+    push_ep(c, rgd)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""bf16 GEMV pieces the K3 mono kernels share: 16 weight rows a task against up
+to 16 token rows in LDS, one ``mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16`` per 32 K.
+
+K is walked in 128-wide chunks, wave w taking chunks w, w + 8, ...; a lane reads
+64 contiguous bytes of its row a chunk (4 dwordx4 at q 32 + g 8 elements: lane
+group g = lane / 16), and the token rows are read at the same K. The K order
+inside a chunk is a permutation both operands share, so the dot is unchanged.
+"""
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl.expr import gpu, range_constexpr
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ops import (
+    CM_NT,
+    mfma_bf16,
+    rsrc,
+    traced,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import (
+    THREADS,
+    WAVES,
+)
+
+ROWS = 16
+KCH = 128
+LDS_PAD = 8  # bf16 a padded token row
+
+
+def chunks(k):
+    """A wave's K chunks for K = ``k``: (count a wave, total)."""
+    n = k // KCH
+    return (n + WAVES - 1) // WAVES, n
+
+
+def loads(lane, wave, w, row0, k, nt=True, ldk=None, k0=0):
+    """This wave's operands of weight rows ``row0`` .. + 16 (row-major, ``ldk``
+    bf16 a row at ``w``, K columns ``k0`` .. ``k0 + k``): a list a chunk
+    (clamped into K: ``mfmas`` zeroes the extra)."""
+    per, n = chunks(k)
+    ldk = k if ldk is None else ldk
+    r_w = rsrc(w)
+    row = row0 + lane % ROWS
+    g = lane // ROWS
+    out = []
+    for i in range(per):
+        ch = fx.min(wave + WAVES * i, n - 1)
+        base = (row * ldk + k0 + ch * KCH + g * 8) // 2
+        out.append(
+            [
+                fx.Vector(
+                    bo.buffer_load(
+                        r_w,
+                        base + 16 * q,
+                        vec_width=4,
+                        dtype=T.i32,
+                        cache_modifier=CM_NT if nt else 0,
+                    )
+                )
+                for q in range(4)
+            ]
+        )
+    return out
+
+
+def mfmas(lane, wave, xl, xrow, k, s, ops):
+    """``loads``' operands against token rows 0 .. s - 1 of the LDS rows ``xl``
+    (``xrow`` bf16 a row) -> this wave's 16x16 accumulator."""
+    per, n = chunks(k)
+    g = lane // ROWS
+    t = fx.min(lane % ROWS, s - 1)
+    acc = fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32)
+    for i in range_constexpr(per):
+        ch = wave + WAVES * i
+        live = ch < n
+        kk = fx.min(ch, n - 1) * KCH + g * 8
+        for q in range_constexpr(4):
+            xb = fx.Vector(
+                fx.ptr_load(
+                    xl + (t * xrow + kk + 32 * q) // 2,
+                    result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Int32),
+                )
+            )
+            if const_live(per, n):
+                xb = fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                    [live.select(xb[d], fx.Int32(0)) for d in range(4)], fx.Int32
+                )
+            acc = mfma_bf16(
+                ops[i][q].bitcast(fx.BFloat16), xb.bitcast(fx.BFloat16), acc
+            )
+    return acc
+
+
+def const_live(per, n):
+    """Whether some wave's last chunk is past K (its MFMA must add zero)."""
+    return per * WAVES != n
+
+
+@traced
+def rows_to_lds(tid, src, k, s, xl, xrow, cm=0, ldk=None, k0=0):
+    """Columns k0 .. k0 + k of token rows 0 .. s - 1 of the bf16 [s, ldk] at
+    ``src`` -> LDS (``xrow`` a row), 16 B a lane."""
+    ldk = k if ldk is None else ldk
+    words = s * k // 8
+    for i in range_constexpr((words + THREADS - 1) // THREADS):
+        e = fx.min(tid + THREADS * i, words - 1)
+        t = e // (k // 8)
+        kk = e % (k // 8) * 8
+        v = fx.Vector(
+            bo.buffer_load(
+                rsrc(src),
+                (t * ldk + k0 + kk) // 2,
+                vec_width=4,
+                dtype=T.i32,
+                cache_modifier=cm,
+            )
+        )
+        if tid + THREADS * i < words:
+            fx.ptr_store(v, xl + (t * xrow + kk) // 2)
+    gpu.barrier()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""K2 phase 2c and 3a (README, "K2 program order"): the pooler and the
+pre-expert norm + MXFP4 a1.
+
+    pooler  (CTA P0 + task, task < 128: g = task // 4, q = task % 4) pooled
+            columns n0 = 512 rank + 16 g .. + 16 against ffn_in's K quarter q
+            (``xrow``, the 16 seam slices covering it): a 16-row bf16 GEMV
+            (``gemv``); parts q > 0 hand their fp32 partials to part 0
+            (PPART), which adds them in part order, rounds to bf16 once and
+            all-gathers the rows (every rank's POOL).
+    load_xq (every CTA) all 4096 pooled columns of every row -> the
+            pre-expert RMSNorm (``fused_rmsnorm_expand``: x rsqrt(mean x^2 +
+            eps), times (w + 1), bf16) -> MXFP4 a1 by aiter's HIP RoundUp rule
+            (``fused_dynamic_mx_quant_moe_sort``: a 32-group's amax floored at
+            1e-10, the ceil code of amax * f32(1/6), RNE e2m1) -> LDS ``xq``
+            (fp4 words) and ``xsc`` (codes), the ug stage's B operand.
+
+Every CTA computes identical a1 bytes from identical inputs, so nothing is
+handed off. A pad row's normed values are zeros by ``select`` (its a1 is fp4
+zeros with the floor's code 92).
+
+The pooler is K3's early latent task (pr60683 ``mono/stages/moe.py``
+``early_loads`` / ``early_compute`` / ``early_out``) at Muse's shapes;
+``load_xq`` is K3's ``load_latq`` with the norm and the 1e-10 floor added.
+"""
+
+import functools
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl.expr import gpu, range_constexpr
+from flydsl.expr import math as fmath
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.mx import (
+    e8m0_roundup,
+    pk_fp4_bf16,
+    pow2,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ops import (
+    CM_DEV,
+    bf2_f32,
+    bf16_pair,
+    hw_rsq,
+    ld_pad,
+    row_sum,
+    rsrc,
+    traced,
+    wave_sum,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import (

+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.spec import (
+    AMAX_FLOOR,
+    COLS,
+    GAIN,
+    HIDDEN,
+    MOE_HIDDEN,
+    OWN_COLS,
+    P_K,
+    P_PARTS,

+XL_ROW = P_K + gemv.LDS_PAD  # bf16 a token row of the pooler's LDS x slice
+SLICES_A_PART = P_K // COLS  # 16 seam slices cover a K quarter

+GROUP_WORDS = GROUP // 2  # 16 bf16 pair words a group
+assert XSC_WORDS * GROUP == MOE_HIDDEN and XQ_WORDS * 8 == MOE_HIDDEN

+
+@functools.cache
+def lds_struct(s: int):
+    """The pooler's LDS: the K quarter of rows 0 .. s-1 of ffn_in (bf16, a
+    row every ``XL_ROW``)."""
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class PoolLds:
+        xl: fx.Array[fx.Int32, s * XL_ROW // 2, 16]
+
+    return PoolLds
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def xq_lds_struct(s: int):
+    """``load_xq``'s LDS, live until the last ug task (K2's layer build
+    composes it with ``experts.ug_lds_struct`` as ``xq_ug``): ``xq`` row t's
+    fp4 words (word ``t 512 + 4 kb + w``: K ``32 kb + 8 w ..``), ``xsc`` its
+    e8m0 codes (a word each, ``t 128 + kb``), ``xss`` the 32-groups' sums of
+    squares."""
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class XqLds:
+        xq: fx.Array[fx.Int32, s * XQ_WORDS, 16]
+        xsc: fx.Array[fx.Int32, s * XSC_WORDS, 16]
+        xss: fx.Array[fx.Float32, s * XSC_WORDS, 16]
+
+    return XqLds

+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- pooler
+
+
+def _task(c, task):
+    """(g, q, n0): the pooler task's row group, K quarter and first pooled
+    column (row of ``w_pool``)."""
+    g = task // P_PARTS
+    q = task % P_PARTS
+    return g, q, c["rank"] * OWN_COLS + g * ROWS
+
+
+def pool_loads(c, task):
+    """Pooler task ``task``'s ``w_pool`` operands for this wave: rows n0 .. +16,
+    K ``2048 q ..`` (2 chunks a wave, nontemporal). Issued before the XRDY
+    waits."""
+    _, q, n0 = _task(c, task)
+    return gemv.loads(
+        c["lane"], c["wave"], c["args"]["w_pool"], n0, P_K, ldk=HIDDEN, k0=q * P_K
+    )
+
+
+@traced
+def stage_pool(c, task, ops):
+    """Pooler task ``task``: its K quarter of rows 0 .. S-1 of xrow -> LDS
+    (after the 16 seam slices covering it) -> ``gemv.mfmas`` -> fp32 rows.
+    q > 0: PPART. q == 0: + the 3 parts in part order -> bf16 -> every rank's
+    POOL (element ``t 4096 + col``)."""
+    s, tid, lane, wave, red = c["S"], c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"], c["red"]
+    g, q, n0 = _task(c, task)
+    xl = c["lds"]["pool"]["xl"]
+    if tid < SLICES_A_PART:
+        c["poll"]([(c["scr"]["xrdy"], q * SLICES_A_PART + tid, 1)])
+    gpu.barrier()

+        tid, c["scr"][XROW], P_K, s, xl, XL_ROW, CM_DEV, ldk=HIDDEN, k0=q * P_K
+    )
+    acc = gemv.mfmas(lane, wave, xl, XL_ROW, P_K, s, ops)
+    fx.ptr_store(acc, red + (wave * 64 + lane) * 4)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if (q > 0) & (tid < s * ROWS):
+        r = tid % ROWS
+        t = tid // ROWS
+        c["put"](c["scr"]["ppart"], ppart_pair(g, q, t, r), row_sum(red, r, t))
+    if (q == 0) & (tid < s * (ROWS // 2)):
+        rp = tid % (ROWS // 2)
+        t = tid // (ROWS // 2)
+        # rows 2 rp and 2 rp + 1 are adjacent pairs of each part
+        got = c["poll"](
+            [
+                (c["scr"]["ppart"], ppart_pair(g, qq, t, 2 * rp), 2)
+                for qq in range(1, P_PARTS)
+            ]
+        )
+        v0 = row_sum(red, 2 * rp, t)
+        v1 = row_sum(red, 2 * rp + 1, t)
+        for qq in range_constexpr(P_PARTS - 1):
+            v0 = v0 + got[qq][0].bitcast(fx.Float32)
+            v1 = v1 + got[qq][1].bitcast(fx.Float32)
+        at = t * MOE_HIDDEN + n0 + 2 * rp
+        for p in range_constexpr(TP):
+            c["put_bf"](c["peer"]["pool"][p], at, [v0, v1])
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- a1
+
+
+def _group_quant(ws, wq, r, pad_t):
+    """A 32-group: pooled bf16 pair words ``ws`` (16), pre-expert weight pair
+    words ``wq`` (16), the row's rsqrt ``r``, its pad flag -> (the e8m0 code,
+    the 4 fp4 words). xe = bf16((p r) (w + 1)), as
+    ``_rmsnorm_expand_kernel``; then the HIP RoundUp quant of those bf16."""
+    xe = []
+    am = fx.Int32(0)
+    for m in range(GROUP_WORDS):
+        p0, p1 = bf2_f32(ws[m])
+        w0, w1 = bf2_f32(wq[m])
+        y0 = (p0 * r) * (w0 + fx.Float32(GAIN))
+        y1 = (p1 * r) * (w1 + fx.Float32(GAIN))
+        word = bf16_pair(y0, y1).bitcast(fx.Int32)
+        word = fx.Int32(pad_t.select(fx.Int32(0), word))
+        xe.append(word)
+        # |bf16| ordered as its magnitude bits (finite values)
+        am = fx.max(am, word & 0x7FFF)
+        am = fx.max(am, (word >> 16) & 0x7FFF)
+    amax = fx.max((am << 16).bitcast(fx.Float32), fx.Float32(AMAX_FLOOR))
+    code = e8m0_roundup(amax)
+    scale = pow2(code)
+    pks = []
+    for w in range(GROUP // 8):
+        pk = fx.Int32(0)
+        for j in range(4):
+            pk = pk_fp4_bf16(pk, xe[4 * w + j], scale, j)
+        pks.append(pk)
+    return code, pks
+
+
+@traced
+def load_xq(c):
+    """POOL (all 4096 columns of rows 0 .. S-1) -> pre-expert norm -> MXFP4:
+    LDS ``xq`` / ``xsc`` (and ``tot``: a row's sum of squares). Thread a
+    32-group b = tid + 512 i: row t = b // 128, columns ``32 kb ..``
+    (kb = b % 128)."""
+    s, tid, lane, wave = c["S"], c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    a = c["args"]
+    lds = c["lds"]["xq"]
+    xq, xsc, xss = lds["xq"], lds["xsc"], lds["xss"]
+    tot = c["rt"]["tot"]
+    ngrp = s * XSC_WORDS
+    r_w = rsrc(a["w_preexp"])
+    # every round's weights and pad byte before the first POOL wait (the
+    # "loads before waits" rule: at S > 4 a thread has two rounds)
+    pre = []
+    for i in range_constexpr(cdiv(ngrp, THREADS)):
+        b = fx.min(tid + THREADS * i, ngrp - 1)
+        t = b // XSC_WORDS
+        kb = b % XSC_WORDS
+        wq = []
+        for h in range_constexpr(GROUP_WORDS // 4):
+            v = fx.Vector(
+                bo.buffer_load(r_w, kb * GROUP_WORDS + 4 * h, vec_width=4, dtype=T.i32)
+            )
+            wq += [v[e] for e in range(4)]
+        pre.append((i, b, t, kb, wq, ld_pad(a["pad"], t)))
+    groups = []
+    for i, b, t, kb, wq, pad_t in pre:
+        got = c["poll"](
+            [
+                (c["peer"]["pool_own"], pool_pair(t, GROUP * kb) + 2 * jj, 2)
+                for jj in range(GROUP_WORDS // 2)
+            ]
+        )
+        ws = [got[jj][m] for jj in range(GROUP_WORDS // 2) for m in range(2)]
+        gss = fx.Float32(0.0)
+        for m in range_constexpr(GROUP_WORDS):
+            p0, p1 = bf2_f32(ws[m])
+            gss = fx.Float32(fmath.fma(p0, p0, gss))
+            gss = fx.Float32(fmath.fma(p1, p1, gss))
+        if tid + THREADS * i < ngrp:
+            fx.ptr_store(gss, xss + b)
+        groups.append((i, t, kb, wq, ws, pad_t))
+    gpu.barrier()
+    # a row's sum of squares: its 128 group sums, a wave a row
+    if wave < s:
+        v = fx.ptr_load(xss + (wave * XSC_WORDS + lane)) + fx.ptr_load(
+            xss + (wave * XSC_WORDS + 64 + lane)
+        )
+        v = wave_sum(v)
+        if lane == 0:
+            fx.ptr_store(v, tot + wave)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    for i, t, kb, wq, ws, pad_t in groups:
+        # sum / D + eps: one fma, as the stock kernel compiles (v_fmamk_f32;
+        # bit-equal to mul + add here: 1 / 4096 is a power of two)
+        r = hw_rsq(
+            fmath.fma(
+                fx.ptr_load(tot + t),
+                fx.Float32(1.0 / MOE_HIDDEN),
+                fx.Float32(PRE_EXP_EPS),
+            )
+        )
+        code, pks = _group_quant(ws, wq, r, pad_t)
+        if tid + THREADS * i < ngrp:
+            for w in range_constexpr(GROUP // 8):
+                fx.ptr_store(pks[w], xq + (t * XQ_WORDS + kb * (GROUP // 8) + w))
+            fx.ptr_store(code, xsc + (t * XSC_WORDS + kb))
+    gpu.barrier()

+"""K2 phase 4a ``owner``: the column-owner per-route reduce of the routed
+experts' rows, the post-expert RMSNorm (its sum of squares exchanged between
+the owners), the route weighting and the top-k sum -> every rank's ``moe``.
+
+Stock (``MuseSparkTopKWeightAndReduce`` then ``fused_post_expert_finalize``,
+common/ops/fused_finalize.py:10-70): ``R = all_reduce(rows.float())`` [S, 8,
+4096], ``x = R (w + 1)``, ``scale = rsqrt(sum_c x^2 / 4096 + 1e-8) tw``,
+``moe = bf16(sum_k x scale)``.
+
+Here rank r owns the 512 pooled columns 512 r .. (``OWN_COLS``); its 32 owner
+CTAs (j, columns 16 j .. of the 512) take every pick's 16 columns:
+
+    R      the 8 ranks' bf16 rows of the pick (``rsx``, pushed by the down CTAs
+           to the column owner only), summed in fp32 in rank order, never
+           rounded (README, Numerics: the deviation)
+    x      R (w_postexp + GAIN): the weight first, as stock
+    pss    the pick's sum of x^2 over the CTA's 16 columns -> every owner CTA of
+           this rank; each sums the 32 in a fixed order (rank-local, scratch)
+    sqx    owner CTA 0's sum over the rank's 512 columns -> every rank; each
+           owner sums the 8 ranks' in rank order: the pick's sum of squares
+           over all 4096 columns, the same bits on every rank
+    xs     x rsqrt(ss / 4096 + POST_EXP_EPS) tw, 0 on a pad row and on a pick
+           of route weight 0 (``select``: NaN in a dead pick's rows cannot
+           leak)
+    moe    the 8 picks of a row summed as a fixed tree, bf16 -> every rank
+           (``moe`` all-gather: rank r writes columns 512 r ..)
+
+The tree sum and the per-pick sum of squares are bit-identical on every rank
+(same values, same order), so every rank's ``moe`` row is the same.
+"""
+
+import functools
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from flydsl.expr import gpu, range_constexpr
+
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common import route_lds
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ops import (
+    bf2_f32,
+    butterfly,
+    hw_rsq,
+    ld_i32,
+    ld_pad,
+    traced,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ranks import (
+    sum_partials,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.sync import (
+    uniform_addr,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.spec import (
+    GAIN,
+    MOE_HIDDEN,
+    OWN_COLS,
+    POST_EXP_EPS,
+    RED_TASKS,
+    ROWS,
+    TOPK,
+    TP,
+    pss_pair,
+    rsx_pair,
+    sqx_pair,
+)
+
+PICK_LANES = ROWS // 2  # threads a pick: 2 of its 16 columns each
+PSS_PER_LANE = RED_TASKS // PICK_LANES  # 4 of the 32 owner slices a lane sums
+assert PSS_PER_LANE * PICK_LANES == RED_TASKS
+assert TOPK * PICK_LANES == 64  # a row's picks fill one wave: S rows, S waves
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def lds_struct(s: int):
+    """``xs``: every pick's 16 weighted, normed columns (f32 [s 8 16])."""
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class ReduceLds:
+        xs: fx.Array[fx.Float32, s * TOPK * ROWS, 16]
+
+    return ReduceLds
+
+
+# Index helpers: plain integer arithmetic on Python ints and traced values
+# alike (the CPU tests check the protocol with the same formulas).
+
+
+def owner_col(j, rp):
+    """The owned column (0 .. OWN_COLS) of owner CTA j's lane pair rp."""
+    return j * ROWS + 2 * rp
+
+
+def global_col(rank, cc):
+    """Owned column ``cc`` of rank ``rank`` in the pooled width (0 .. 4096)."""
+    return rank * OWN_COLS + cc
+
+
+def pss_lane_slices(rp):
+    """The owner slices a pick's lane rp sums (4 of 32, in order)."""
+    return [PSS_PER_LANE * rp + i for i in range(PSS_PER_LANE)]
+
+
+def moe_elem(t, col):
+    """``moe`` element index (``put_bf``) of row t, pooled column col: 2
+    ``spec.moe_pair`` for an even col."""
+    return t * MOE_HIDDEN + col
+
+
+def topk_tree(xs):
+    """The fixed sum of a row's 8 picks: ((0 + 1) + (2 + 3)) + ((4 + 5) + (6 + 7))."""
+    assert len(xs) == TOPK == 8
+    return ((xs[0] + xs[1]) + (xs[2] + xs[3])) + ((xs[4] + xs[5]) + (xs[6] + xs[7]))
+
+
+def _f32(w):
+    return w.bitcast(fx.Float32)
+
+
+@traced
+def stage_owner(c, j):
+    """Owner CTA j of this rank (columns 16 j .. of its 512): a thread a pick's
+    two columns (pick = t 8 + k, ``rsx`` -> R -> x -> the pick's sum of squares
+    via ``pss`` and ``sqx`` -> xs in LDS), then a thread a row's two columns
+    (the top-k sum -> every rank's ``moe``). Ends with a barrier (``xs`` is in
+    the stage union)."""
+    s, tid, wave = c["S"], c["tid"], c["wave"]
+    a, rt, rank = c["args"], c["rt"], c["rank"]
+    xs = c["lds"]["reduce"]["xs"]
+    # thread tid < S 64 -> (pick, rp): the first S waves (S 8 picks x 8 lanes
+    # is S whole waves, so the butterflies below see whole 8-lane groups);
+    # the other waves poll nothing and only take the barriers
+    if wave < s:
+        pick = tid // PICK_LANES
+        t = pick // TOPK
+        k = pick % TOPK
+        rp = tid % PICK_LANES
+        cc = owner_col(j, rp)
+        # weights and route data first (none waits on a producer)
+        w0, w1 = bf2_f32(ld_i32(a["w_postexp"], global_col(rank, cc) // 2))
+        w0 = w0 + fx.Float32(GAIN)
+        w1 = w1 + fx.Float32(GAIN)
+        tw = route_lds.load_weight(rt, t, k)
+        pad_t = ld_pad(a["pad"], t)
+        # R: the 8 ranks' partials in rank order, fp32
+        r0, r1 = sum_partials(
+            c["poll"], c["peer"]["rsx_own"], lambda src: rsx_pair(src, pick, cc), TP
+        )
+        x0 = r0 * w0
+        x1 = r1 * w1
+        # the pick's sum of squares: 16 columns (lanes rp ^ 4, 2, 1 of the pick)
+        ps = butterfly(x0 * x0 + x1 * x1, (4, 2, 1))
+        if rp == 0:
+            c["put"](c["scr"]["pss"], pss_pair(j, pick), ps)
+        # ... the rank's 512: lane rp sums slices 4 rp .. 4 rp + 3, then the
+        # 8 lanes
+        # (polls after a predicated put go through ``uniform_addr``: no
+        # readfirstlane waterfall around the poll loads)
+        sl = pss_lane_slices(rp)
+        pss = uniform_addr(c["scr"]["pss"])
+        pv = c["poll"]([(pss, pss_pair(q, pick), 1) for q in sl])
+        own = ((_f32(pv[0][0]) + _f32(pv[1][0])) + _f32(pv[2][0])) + _f32(pv[3][0])
+        own = butterfly(own, (4, 2, 1))
+        if (rp == 0) & (fx.Int32(j) == 0):
+            for p in range_constexpr(TP):
+                c["put"](c["peer"]["sqx"][p], sqx_pair(rank, pick), own)
+        # ... all 4096: the 8 owners' in rank order
+        sqx = uniform_addr(c["peer"]["sqx_own"])
+        sq = c["poll"]([(sqx, sqx_pair(src, pick), 1) for src in range(TP)])
+        ss = _f32(sq[0][0])
+        for src in range_constexpr(1, TP):
+            ss = ss + _f32(sq[src][0])
+        scale = (
+            hw_rsq(ss * fx.Float32(1.0 / MOE_HIDDEN) + fx.Float32(POST_EXP_EPS)) * tw
+        )
+        dead = pad_t | (tw == fx.Float32(0.0))
+        y0 = dead.select(fx.Float32(0.0), x0 * scale)
+        y1 = dead.select(fx.Float32(0.0), x1 * scale)
+        fx.ptr_store(fx.Float32(y0), xs + (pick * ROWS + 2 * rp))
+        fx.ptr_store(fx.Float32(y1), xs + (pick * ROWS + 2 * rp + 1))
+    gpu.barrier()
+    # the top-k sum: thread (row tt, pair rp2) -> 2 columns of the row
+    if tid < s * PICK_LANES:
+        tt = tid // PICK_LANES
+        rp2 = tid % PICK_LANES
+        m0 = topk_tree(
+            [fx.ptr_load(xs + ((tt * TOPK + q) * ROWS + 2 * rp2)) for q in range(TOPK)]
+        )
+        m1 = topk_tree(
+            [
+                fx.ptr_load(xs + ((tt * TOPK + q) * ROWS + 2 * rp2 + 1))
+                for q in range(TOPK)
+            ]
+        )
+        pad_tt = ld_pad(a["pad"], tt)
+        m0 = pad_tt.select(fx.Float32(0.0), m0)
+        m1 = pad_tt.select(fx.Float32(0.0), m1)
+        col = global_col(rank, owner_col(j, rp2))
+        for p in range_constexpr(TP):
+            c["put_bf"](c["peer"]["moe"][p], moe_elem(tt, col), [m0, m1])
+    gpu.barrier()  # the LDS hand-over: the unpooler's xl reuses xs's bytes

+"""K2 phase 2b (README, "K2 program order"): the router and the routing.
+
+    router  (CTA R0 + i, i < 32: expert row e = 32 rank + i) the fp32 logit of
+            e for every row t of ffn_in (``xrow``, announced slice by slice by
+            the seam's XRDY flags): a VALU dot over the fp32 router weight
+            (16 K a thread, fma in K order; no bf16 split of the weight), the
+            waves' partials added in wave order -> every rank's RLOG (the
+            logits all-gather: rank src's 32 experts at (src MT + t) 32 + i).
+    route   (CTA t < S, wave 0, after its seam slice) row t's 256 logits ->
+            sigmoid with an IEEE divide (``tl.sigmoid``-exact) + the
+            selection bias -> the top-8 by a radix select (the 8th largest key
+            by a 32-step ballot bit search; equal keys: the lower experts) ->
+            the 8 ranked by key, descending, the lower expert first on a tie
+            (``tl.argmax``'s rule) -> the unbiased sigmoids summed serially in
+            that order, + ROUTE_EPS, ROUTE_SCALE / sum (IEEE) -> ROUTE.
+
+The routing is ``fused_musespark1x_routing``'s (common/ops/fused_routing.py)
+bit for bit on finite logits: the same sigmoid, the same keys, the same pick
+order, the same serial sum and divide. A pad row gets ids -1 and weights 0 (by
+``select``), as the stock kernel does with ``is_padding``. A NaN logit (a
+warm-up's garbage row) ranks last and adds 0 to the sum; the stock argmax's
+result there depends on its reduction tree.
+
+Adapted from K3's ``stage_route`` (pr60683 ``mono/stages/moe.py``) with E = 256,
+TOPK = 8, the IEEE sigmoid, the epsilon and the pad rows.
+"""
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl.expr import gpu, range_constexpr
+from flydsl.expr import math as fmath
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ops import (
+    CM_DEV,
+    CM_NT,
+    ballot,
+    bf2_f32,
+    ieee_sigmoid,
+    lanes_below,
+    ld_pad,
+    popcount,
+    rsrc,
+    traced,
+    wave_sum,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.specialized_decode.mono.spec import (
+    EXPERTS,
+    EXPERTS_RANK,
+    HIDDEN,
+    MAX_TOKENS,
+    NA,
+    ROUTE_EPS,
+    ROUTE_SCALE,
+    THREADS,
+    TOPK,
+    TP,
+    WAVES,
+    XROW,
+    rlog_pair,
+    route_id_pair,
+    route_weight_pair,
+)
+
+K_THREAD = HIDDEN // THREADS  # 16 K a thread of a router row
+PER = EXPERTS // 64  # 4 logits a lane in the routing (expert lane + 64 u)
+NAN_KEY = -3.0e38  # a NaN score's key: below every finite one
+assert K_THREAD == 16 and PER * 64 == EXPERTS and TOPK <= 64
+
+
+def ld_f32(ptr, i):
+    """Element ``i`` of the fp32 buffer at ``ptr`` (a plain load)."""
+    return fx.Float32(bo.buffer_load(rsrc(ptr), i, vec_width=1, dtype=T.f32))
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- router
+
+
+def router_loads(c, i):
+    """CTA R0 + i's router row (expert ``32 rank + i``): thread tid's 16 fp32
+    weights of K ``16 tid ..`` as 4 dwordx4, nontemporal (the row is read once
+    a step). Issued before ``stage_router``'s XRDY waits."""
+    e = c["rank"] * EXPERTS_RANK + i
+    r_w = rsrc(c["args"]["w_router"])
+    base = e * HIDDEN + K_THREAD * c["tid"]
+    return [
+        fx.Vector(
+            bo.buffer_load(
+                r_w, base + 4 * q, vec_width=4, dtype=T.i32, cache_modifier=CM_NT
+            )
+        )
+        for q in range(K_THREAD // 4)
+    ]
+
+
+@traced
+def stage_router(c, i, ops):
+    """Expert ``32 rank + i``'s fp32 logits of rows 0 .. S-1 -> every rank's
+    RLOG. Thread tid: 16 products of K ``16 tid ..`` (bf16 x -> fp32, exact) in
+    one fma chain in K order; ``wave_sum``; the 8 waves' sums in wave order."""
+    s, tid, lane, wave, red = c["S"], c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"], c["red"]
+    # every seam slice of xrow: all of K
+    if tid < NA:
+        c["poll"]([(c["scr"]["xrdy"], tid, 1)])
+    gpu.barrier()
+    r_x = rsrc(c["scr"][XROW])
+    wv = [ops[q][j].bitcast(fx.Float32) for q in range(K_THREAD // 4) for j in range(4)]
+    # all rows' x first: 2 dwordx4 a row (16 bf16), device scope (the seam's
+    # plain stores, published by XRDY)
+    xs = []
+    for t in range_constexpr(s):
+        base = t * (HIDDEN // 2) + (K_THREAD // 2) * tid
+        xs.append(
+            [
+                fx.Vector(
+                    bo.buffer_load(
+                        r_x,
+                        base + 4 * h,
+                        vec_width=4,
+                        dtype=T.i32,
+                        cache_modifier=CM_DEV,
+                    )
+                )
+                for h in range(2)
+            ]
+        )
+    for t in range_constexpr(s):
+        acc = fx.Float32(0.0)
+        for h in range_constexpr(2):
+            for j in range_constexpr(4):
+                lo, hi = bf2_f32(xs[t][h][j])
+                k = 8 * h + 2 * j
+                acc = fx.Float32(fmath.fma(lo, wv[k], acc))
+                acc = fx.Float32(fmath.fma(hi, wv[k + 1], acc))
+        tot = wave_sum(acc)
+        if lane == 0:
+            fx.ptr_store(tot, red + (wave * MAX_TOKENS + t))

+        logit = fx.ptr_load(red + tid)
+        for w in range_constexpr(1, WAVES):
+            logit = logit + fx.ptr_load(red + (w * MAX_TOKENS + tid))

+        for p in range_constexpr(TP):
+            c["put"](c["peer"]["rlog"][p], at, logit)
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- route
+
+
+def _okey(v):
+    """An order-preserving uint32 key of an f32 (larger float, larger key)."""
+    b = v.bitcast(fx.Int32)
+    neg = b < fx.Int32(0)
+    return fx.Uint32(neg.select(~b, b ^ fx.Int32(-2147483648)))
+
+
+@traced
+def stage_route(c, t):
+    """Row t's top-8 (wave 0; the other waves only take the barrier): RLOG
+    (every rank's 32 logits of row t) -> ``ieee_sigmoid`` + bias -> the radix
+    select of the 8 largest keys -> ranked by key, lower expert first -> the
+    renormalized unbiased sigmoids -> ROUTE ``t 16 + k`` (id) and
+    ``t 16 + 8 + k`` (weight bits). A pad row: ids -1, weights 0."""
+    lane, wave, red = c["lane"], c["wave"], c["red"]
+    a = c["args"]
+    if wave == 0:
+        # the plain loads go out before the wait
+        pad_t = ld_pad(a["pad"], t)
+        bias = [ld_f32(a["bias"], lane + 64 * u) for u in range(PER)]
+        # expert e = lane + 64 u is rank e // 32's router row e % 32
+        specs = [
+            (
+                c["peer"]["rlog_own"],
+                rlog_pair(
+                    lane // EXPERTS_RANK + (64 // EXPERTS_RANK) * u, t, lane % 32
+                ),
+                1,
+            )
+            for u in range(PER)
+        ]
+        got = c["poll"](specs)
+        keys, sigs = [], []
+        for u in range_constexpr(PER):
+            sg = ieee_sigmoid(got[u][0].bitcast(fx.Float32))
+            sc = sg + bias[u]
+            # sg is never -0, so neither is sc: the integer key orders it as
+            # the float compare does. A NaN (a warm-up's garbage row) ranks
+            # last and weighs nothing.
+            keys.append(_okey((sc == sc).select(sc, fx.Float32(NAN_KEY))))
+            sigs.append((sg == sg).select(sg, fx.Float32(0.0)))
+
+        def count_ge(th):
+            n = fx.Int32(0)
+            for u in range_constexpr(PER):
+                n = n + popcount(ballot(keys[u] >= th))
+            return n
+
+        th = fx.Uint32(0)
+        for bit in range_constexpr(31, -1, -1):
+            cand = th | fx.Uint32(1 << bit)
+            th = (count_ge(cand) >= TOPK).select(cand, th)
+        # selected: key > th, then the lowest experts with key == th
+        n_gt = fx.Int32(0)
+        for u in range_constexpr(PER):
+            n_gt = n_gt + popcount(ballot(keys[u] > th))
+        need = fx.Int32(TOPK) - n_gt
+        eq_before = fx.Int32(0)
+        sel_before = fx.Int32(0)
+        for u in range_constexpr(PER):
+            eqb = ballot(keys[u] == th)
+            eq_rank = eq_before + lanes_below(eqb, lane)
+            sel = (keys[u] > th) | ((keys[u] == th) & (eq_rank < need))
+            selb = ballot(sel)
+            pos = sel_before + lanes_below(selb, lane)
+            if sel:
+                fx.ptr_store(keys[u].bitcast(fx.Float32), red + pos * 3)
+                fx.ptr_store(
+                    fx.Int32(lane + 64 * u).bitcast(fx.Float32), red + (pos * 3 + 1)
+                )
+                fx.ptr_store(sigs[u], red + (pos * 3 + 2))
+            eq_before = eq_before + popcount(eqb)
+            sel_before = sel_before + popcount(selb)

+        # order the stock kernel's 8 argmax steps pick them in
+        q = fx.min(lane, TOPK - 1)
+        mk = fx.Uint32(fx.ptr_load(red + q * 3).bitcast(fx.Int32))
+        me = fx.ptr_load(red + (q * 3 + 1)).bitcast(fx.Int32)
+        ms = fx.ptr_load(red + (q * 3 + 2))
+        rank = fx.Int32(0)
+        for j in range_constexpr(TOPK):
+            ok = fx.Uint32(fx.ptr_load(red + j * 3).bitcast(fx.Int32))
+            oe = fx.ptr_load(red + (j * 3 + 1)).bitcast(fx.Int32)
+            before = (ok > mk) | ((ok == mk) & (oe < me))
+            rank = rank + before.select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0))

+        # IEEE divide (fused_routing.py: score_sum, inv_sum_scaled)
+        if lane < TOPK:
+            fx.ptr_store(ms, red + (64 + rank))
+        total = fx.Float32(0.0)
+        for j in range_constexpr(TOPK):
+            total = total + fx.ptr_load(red + (64 + j))
+        total = total + fx.Float32(ROUTE_EPS)
+        inv = fx.Float32(ROUTE_SCALE) / total
+        rid = fx.Int32(pad_t.select(fx.Int32(-1), me))
+        rw = fx.Float32(pad_t.select(fx.Float32(0.0), ms * inv))
+        if lane < TOPK:
+            c["put"](c["scr"]["route"], route_id_pair(t, rank), rid)
+            c["put"](c["scr"]["route"], route_weight_pair(t, rank), rw)
+    gpu.barrier()
